npcs.name: Halla Bjornsdottir
npcs.idle: My brother found a god in Malmohus. A dragon one.

npcs.name: Svein Hammerhand
npcs.idle: Svartalfar forging Norse steel. My steel, near enough.

npcs.name: Volva Asa
npcs.idle: The volur came south with the Oath. We'll go home with it, or not at all.

npcs.name: Huscarl Ketil
npcs.idle: The King lent the volur his huscarls. He wants them back. Most of them.

quests.title: The Dragon's Missionary
quests.offer:
My brother Bjorn came to Malmohus to hunt with me. Then the drakulv missionaries got to him - the dragon-worshippers. He's taken their scale and their name. He preaches with them in the northern tents.

He's soft-hearted. They found the soft place and pressed. Will you [find Bjorn]? Talk to him. He won't listen to me.
quests.summary: Halla's brother has joined the drakulv dragon-worshippers and preaches with their missionaries.

steps.goal: Go to the drakulv missionaries' tents in the north
steps.text: Drakulv in robes preach to the air, and a few ragged Norse listen, nodding.
A big Norseman in drakulv robes stands among the fallen, praying for them.

steps.say:
Halla sent you. She worries.

You don't understand. The dragon is real. She sleeps under the ice in the south and dreams the world. The drakulv were kind to me when nobody else was. They said I could matter. They're taking me south for the [great rite] at the next moon.

steps.goal: Ambush the drakulv patrol bound for the rite
steps.text: One carries orders for the rite: a sacrifice. A Norse convert, 'big and willing'. They mean Bjorn.

steps.goal: Confront the drakulv preacher who claimed Bjorn
steps.text: The preacher falls. Bjorn, who followed you, stands looking at the orders in his hands.

stages.name: Preacher Vrakulv
stages.announce: A drakulv in a mitre of scales. 'The big one is promised. The dragon is hungry. You are... also acceptable.'

steps.say:
He's here. And he knows, now. He read the orders.

He still wears the scale. He says the dragon isn't the drakulv's fault - that something is really there, under the ice. I don't care what he believes. I care that he's alive.

Should I [take the scale] from him? Or [let him keep it], and pray to his dragon by himself?

options.say: Here, Bjorn. Give it here. ...He gave it to me. He's crying. I'm crying. It's ugly. Here - take it. I don't want it near him.
Then he'll keep it. He can pray to the moon for all I care, as long as he does it here, with me. Thank you.

kept.text: Take this, for bringing him back.

quests.title: Forged in Darkness
quests.offer:
GROUP work. Svartalfar aren't fools, and they don't fight fair.

Someone's forging blades stamped with my mark - the hammer and anvil - and selling them to the drakulv. Good blades, too good. The svartalfar in the east have a forge in the north-east hills.

I want it shut. I want to know who's been [selling my mark]. Will you [shut the forge]?

topics.selling my mark: My hammer and anvil. Only one man in Midgard has the right to stamp it, and he's standing in front of you.

quests.summary: GROUP. Someone is forging blades with Svein Hammerhand's mark and selling them to the drakulv - from a svartalf forge in the north-east.

steps.goal: Kill the svartalf infiltrators on the eastern road
steps.text: One carries a drakulv purse and a letter: 'Thirty more blades by the new moon. The smith's mark, as before. -E.'

steps.goal: Search the svartalf forge in the north-east

clue.name: a crate of blades stamped with a hammer and anvil

steps.text: Thirty blades. Svein's mark on every one. And a ledger: 'E.' has been paid in svartalf gold for each - E, for Egil, Svein's own apprentice.
The forge's fires gutter out. Behind the anvil, a young Norse smith in a leather apron raises his hands.

stages.name: Forgemaster Dvalinn the Black
stages.announce: A svartalf in a mask of soot steps out of the forge-smoke, hammer smoking. 'Northmen. You've cost me a customer.'

steps.say:
Egil. My Egil. I taught him to hold tongs. I was going to leave him the forge.

He's outside, waiting. He says the svartalfar threatened his mother. He says he was going to tell me. Maybe it's true.

The jarl hangs men who sell steel to the enemy. I could [hand him over]. Or [forgive him], and he works my forge for nothing till he's grey, and I watch him every day. You've seen the ledger. You choose.

options.say: ...The jarl's men are already coming up the road. I'll walk him down myself. Leave me alone a while after.
Forgiven. Not forgotten. He'll work till his arms fall off. ...Thank you. I didn't want to be the man who hanged his own boy.

law.text: Take something from the forge. I can't look at any of it.

quests.title: The Missionary Road
quests.offer:
Every missionary who ever walked into Midgard came down the road west of here. They still do - and they still walk back with converts.

Will you [close the road]?
quests.summary: Drakulv missionaries walk Malmohus's missionary road, north into Midgard and back with converts.

steps.goal: Close the road to the drakulv missionaries about 540 m north-west of Huscarl Ketil

steps.say: Closed, for a day. The Oath will close it for good. The road's the first post we take.

quests.title: The Patrols
quests.offer:
I walked with the drakulv once. I know their patrols - they walk the north roads in fours, and they take anyone alone. Break them.

Will you [break the patrols]?
quests.summary: Patrolling drakulv walk Malmohus's north roads in fours and take anyone alone.

steps.goal: Break the patrolling drakulv about 170 m south of Bjorn the Convert

steps.say: Good. I prayed to her once. Now I pray she stays asleep.

quests.title: The Infiltrators
quests.offer:
Svartalf infiltrators creep up to the camp at night - they want my forge-marks, my steel. They sell everything to the drakulv.

Will you [hunt them]?
quests.summary: Svartalf infiltrators creep up to Halla's camp at night for the drakulv.

steps.goal: Hunt the svartalf infiltrators about 280 m north-east of Svein Hammerhand

steps.say: Good. Every one is a forge-mark they won't sell.

quests.title: The Bloodbinders
quests.offer:
The svartalf bloodbinders in the foist bind their own blood to the dragon's for her scale. They're her svartalf now - and they keep the foist warded.

Bring friends. Will you [break the bloodbinders]?
quests.summary: Svartalf bloodbinders bind their blood to Gjalpinulva's in the Svartalf Foist.

steps.goal: Break the svartalf bloodbinders about 400 m east of Volva Asa

clue.name: a bowl of dark blood and red scale

steps.text: The blood in the bowl moves on its own. Scratched under it: 'For the Mother's waking. When the Hierophant has her name, every bound drop wakes with her.'

steps.say: Every bound drop wakes with her. The svartalf don't know what they sold. The foist is the second post - the Oath will break it.

default.text: From the Oath of the Volur.

quests.title: The Drakulv's Hounds
quests.offer:
The scaled vargs - the drakulv breed them, half wolf, half drake. They run the backwoods and the lines. I hunt them, when I can.

Will you [hunt with me]?
quests.summary: The drakulv's scaled vargs, half wolf and half drake, run Malmohus's backwoods.

steps.goal: Hunt the scaled varg snarlers about 630 m west of Halla Bjornsdottir

steps.say: Good hunting. I'll make a cloak of the next one.

quests.title: The Armguard Lines
quests.offer:
The drakulv dig in across the middle of Malmohus - armguards and axehands. Thin them, and the Oath can take the lines.

Will you [thin the lines]?
quests.summary: Drakulv armguards and axehands dig in across the middle of Malmohus.

steps.goal: Thin the drakulv armguards about 560 m south-west of Huscarl Ketil

steps.say: Thinner. The sacrificers on the lines keep the rite going for the temple. Asa wants to hear about them.

quests.title: The Rite
quests.offer:
The sacrificers keep the rite burning on the lines - blood and fire, to keep the dragon's sleep light, so she'll wake quick when her name's spoken.

Bring friends. Will you [break the rite]?
quests.summary: Drakulv sacrificers keep the rite burning on Malmohus's lines to keep Gjalpinulva's sleep light.

steps.goal: Break the drakulv sacrificers about 410 m south of Volva Asa

clue.name: a scroll in a scale case, half-burnt

steps.text: The Hierophant's hand: 'The Mother's name is two halves. I have the first. The volva at Galplen has the second - she has fled south with the Oath. When she stands before my temple, I will have it from her.'

steps.say: She's come south. Groa. She brought the half-name to us - and the Hierophant wants her to stand at his temple. Then we'll give him what he wants: Groa at his temple, and the Oath behind her.

default.text: From the Oath of the Volur.

quests.title: The Temple Steps
quests.offer:
The drakulv protectors hold the temple steps, with their executioners. They're the best the dragon has.

Will you [thin the steps]?
quests.summary: Drakulv protectors and executioners hold the steps of the Wyrm-Temple.

steps.goal: Thin the drakulv protectors about 750 m south-west of Huscarl Ketil

steps.say: Thinner. The disciples in the west of the steps - they're the Hierophant's own. Asa wants them.

quests.title: The Hierophant's Disciples
quests.offer:
The Hierophant's own disciples and soultrappers. They carry his half of the name between them, a syllable each. Break them, and he has only what he carries himself.

Bring friends. Will you [break the disciples]?
quests.summary: The Hierophant's disciples and soultrappers carry his half of Gjalpinulva's name.

steps.goal: Break the drakulv disciples about 920 m south-west of Volva Asa

steps.say: Broken. He has his half, and nothing else now. Go to Groa.

default.text: From the Oath of the Volur.

quests.title: The Dragon-Oath
quests.offer:
Look at the temple from the hill - see what's waiting. Then go to Volva Groa, here in the camp, and swear the Oath.

Will you [look at the temple]?
quests.summary: The Oath of the Volur means to march on the Wyrm-Temple, where the Hierophant waits for Gjalpinulva's name.

steps.goal: Climb the hill above the Wyrm-Temple
steps.text: A temple cut into the hill, smoke pouring out of its mouth. Drakulv on every step. And south-west, in the dark of the lair, something vast breathing slowly.

steps.say:
Breathing slowly. Not for long.

Go to Volva Groa and swear it - say [by the Oath]. The road, the foist, the lines, the steps, then the temple. It all goes back if we stop.

default.text: From the Oath of the Volur.
